outcome.independentChallenge: Lead review rejected the initial slice on five concrete gaps: whole-envelope validation before mutation, fairness advancement at acquire, incomplete v18 fixture, absent two-store concurrency test, and null-WakeId acceptance. Those were corrected and a second independent P2 found that two dispatchers could select from the same stale fairness state and both reserve a lane beyond the realtime burst or N/B alternating turn. Reservation now checks the requested lane against the persisted fairness state and currently eligible lanes under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; a rejected contender reloads the state and continues the remaining bounded scan. Barrier tests starting at realtime burst 3 prove only one fourth RT grant and that the other dispatcher gets Normal; a competing N/B test proves Background then Normal with MaxInFlight=2. Focused concurrency tests passed 2/2; full API passed 347 with 1 skipped; full Collector passed 393; solution build passed with 0 warnings/0 errors; format verify, CodeGraph sync/query, audit validator and diff checks passed. Cross-component Lambda transient-retry and HTTP/telemetry work remain outside this dispatched write slice.
